scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: Two stamps appear
scenes.caption: At the simulated kit counter, Reva finds a request stamped both approve and review. Nikhil checks the card rather than blaming the volunteer. Independent rules can both run; a correct comparison alone cannot guarantee one outcome.
scenes.speech: At the simulated kit counter, Reva finds a request stamped both approve and review. Nikhil checks the card rather than blaming the volunteer. Independent rules can both run; a correct comparison alone cannot guarantee one outcome.
scenes.dialogue: Can both branches run on this card?

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Combine requirements
scenes.caption: Complete requests qualify only when their token total is at most eight AND the group is registered. A small total cannot compensate for missing registration. Reva writes both truth values before combining them, making the reason for each rejection visible.
scenes.speech: Complete requests qualify only when their token total is at most eight AND the group is registered. A small total cannot compensate for missing registration. Reva writes both truth values before combining them, making the reason for each rejection visible.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Reject conditions
scenes.caption: The same rejection rule can be written as total above eight OR NOT registered. OR needs only one failing requirement. Nikhil tests a registered oversized request and an unregistered small request; both require review for different, explicitly recorded reasons.
scenes.speech: The same rejection rule can be written as total above eight OR NOT registered. OR needs only one failing requirement. Nikhil tests a registered oversized request and an unregistered small request; both require review for different, explicitly recorded reasons.
scenes.dialogue: NOT reverses the registration truth value.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Give unknowns priority
scenes.caption: A card has an unknown total and a valid registration mark. Guessing a numeric value would invent evidence. Choose the branch plan that handles missing information first, then evaluates the complete request, with only one final output for that card.
scenes.speech: A card has an unknown total and a valid registration mark. Guessing a numeric value would invent evidence. Choose the branch plan that handles missing information first, then evaluates the complete request, with only one final output for that card.
scenes.dialogue: Unknown is not a passing number.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Touch the boundary
scenes.caption: They prepare totals just below, exactly at and just above the limit while holding registration fixed. This isolates the comparison error. Testing only small requests cannot reveal accidentally excluded equality.
scenes.speech: They prepare totals just below, exactly at and just above the limit while holding registration fixed. This isolates the comparison error. Testing only small requests cannot reveal accidentally excluded equality.
scenes.dialogue: Change one feature when testing a boundary.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: A single outcome
scenes.caption: Their corrected decision sheet records the first applicable branch and stops. Every output includes its reason, so review does not hide whether data was missing or a condition failed. Keep those reasons when you test a later policy change.
scenes.speech: Their corrected decision sheet records the first applicable branch and stops. Every output includes its reason, so review does not hide whether data was missing or a condition failed. Keep those reasons when you test a later policy change.
scenes.dialogue: The branch order is part of the rule.
